preconditions.description: The number of students n must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of top scoring students k must be between 1 and n.
The minimum score l must be less than or equal to the maximum score r.
The total score sall must be between 1 and 1000000.
The total score of the top k students sk must be between 1 and sall.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n integers representing the scores of the students.

postconditions.expression: all(l <= int(score) <= r for score in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: Each score must be between l and r.

postconditions.expression: sum(int(score) for score in stdout.split()) == sall
postconditions.description: The sum of all scores must equal sall.

postconditions.expression: sum(sorted([int(score) for score in stdout.split()], reverse=True)[:k]) == sk
postconditions.description: The sum of the top k scores must equal sk.
